findings.message: Present but not fully met as worded: running the whole plugin suite (`npx tsx --test 'src/**/__tests__/*.test.ts'` in vscode-plugin) gave 1206 tests, 1191 pass, 2 fail, 5 cancelled, 8 skipped. The 2 failures are the two expected manifest-catalog tests. The 5 cancelled are all in src/__tests__/activation.test.ts (tests 2-6, 'Promise resolution is still pending but the event loop has already resolved'), reproducible when that file runs alone. That file and src/activation.ts were last touched on 2026-09-24 and are outside this Story's changed set, so this is not a regression from the Story, but the suite is not clean 'apart from the two manifest-catalog tests'. Every chat test this Story promised is present by its exact name and passed in this run. Caveat on grounding: the graph's testsReaching edges only record named helper functions, not the anonymous test() callbacks, so the empty edges on symbols such as parsePatch internals, reconcileSections, runCheck, settlePath, endDiffTurn and latestDiffVersions are a hollow-grounding artefact, not coverage gaps; I judged coverage from the run instead and raise no finding from those empty edges.
findings.expectationRef: The whole plugin suite passes apart from the two manifest-catalog tests that fail before this change

findings.message: The test helper `diff(over: Record<string, unknown>): TranscriptEntry` builds a diff transcript row from overrides, and the same builder with the same signature exists in transcript-window.test.ts:95 (also as `diffRow` in render-registry.test.ts:1152 and `diffRowMsg` in chat-shell.test.ts:381). Four independent copies of the diff-row shape can drift when the row's fields change; a single builder in `__tests__/fixtures.ts`, next to the already-shared `patchOf`, would remove that. Test-only duplication, so it does not block.

`runTurn` now carries the diff-turn lifecycle (openDiffTurn, pushMarker, pathLine, settlePath, settleHeld, endDiffTurn, warnGovernor) on top of streaming, approvals, titling and persistence — 16 distinct callees inside the `createChatPanelHost` closure, which itself has 57. The summaries show `endDiffTurn` reached from four exit paths (runTurn, handleMessage, wireChannel, the host), so the 'diff state ended on every exit' guarantee depends on each path remembering the call. Judged from the call edges only, not the body; no defect is shown, this is a maintainability observation.
